reference_inputs.role: actual original four-camera hauler screen geometry/edit target

prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: OpenTTD orbital cargo hauler17, original diagnostic DISPLAY ONLY, BLOCKED static cue, N/NE/E/SE cameras.
Image1 is the approved empty hauler with its original four actual cameras and navy command-head display. Render ONLY each camera's SAME original flat rectangular diagnostic display with its thin existing pale-ivory beveled surround. Remove all surrounding spacecraft: NO head housing, deck, rails, nozzle, engine, cargo or other hardware. Preserve each display's genuine physical projected shape, aspect, shallow thickness and fixed upper-left SCREEN lighting.

Change ONLY the navy glass face to a clear warm AMBER illuminated blocked face, with a very thin dark navy edge. Broad simple steady amber area, no text/symbols/pattern/LEDs/buttons or extra fixtures, no glow/halo. Only the original display face illuminates. No service blue/cyan variant, no animation. Cargo/blocking rules remain elsewhere.

Four isolated display cutouts in a1536x1024 transparent2x2 sheet, one actual camera per panel:
TOP LEFT N: original far command-head display, near-horizontal wide shallow rectangle as in the input N rear view.
TOP RIGHT NE: actual upper-right facing command-head display, the same sloped face in rear-three-quarter projection.
BOTTOM LEFT E: actual RIGHT-side command-head display, narrow almost edge-on projected face, faithfully matching the input E-side view. Do not replace with a front-on rectangle.
BOTTOM RIGHT SE: actual near LOWER-RIGHT command-head display in the input front-three-quarter projection.
One physical display in all4views, genuine3D physical camera projections, no flat bitmap mirroring/rotation or duplicated unrotated fronts. Crisp detailed industrial isometric game artwork, low orthographic2:1 camera about26.565degrees elevation, upper-left SCREEN light, pale ivory surround/navy edge/bright warm amber face.

SAFE BORDERED layout: four straight opaque pure-magenta #FF00FF6px separator frames at N(24,24)-(744,488),NE(792,24)-(1512,488),E(24,536)-(744,1000),SE(792,536)-(1512,1000). Each whole display small and centered within its panel, maximum260px wide/180px tall, one uniform physical scale; at least64px TRUE TRANSPARENT clearance on every side. The E view stays physically narrow; do not enlarge it to match front-view width. Entire background, margins and gutters true alpha0. No haze, checkerboard, gray/white backdrop, ground plane, castshadow, labels, arrows, watermark or extra props. Four complete separate original DISPLAY-ONLY cutouts with amber on the existing face.

unaccepted_directions.SE: Generated long screen edges slope down-right; actual selected SE screen slopes up-right. Do not repair by rotation/mirroring or reuse it through a new transform.

actual_camera_mapping.evidence: Screen long edge slopes down-right, matching original NE face.
Narrow steep side projection, original head faces right.
Wrong diagonal display projection; independent correction required.
